app.title: Ichimon
newGame.lead: You are a retired wrestler turned stablemaster, and today you opened your own stable. A few disciples, a new signboard, a thin bank book. Raise them well and leave someone to inherit the stable before you retire at 65.
newGame.style.yotsu: Grab the belt and drive out
newGame.note: Money, rankings and elder-name rules follow real sumo (some values estimated). Wrestler and stable names are fictional.
action.hint: Set training and recruits, then go to the tournament.
action.hintRetire: A disciple wants to retire. If you continue without answering, the retirement is accepted.
quit.title: Close the stable?
quit.body: This stable's records will be erased.
retire.title: Retirement request
candidates.title: Applicants
candidates.note: Accepted recruits do maezumo next tournament and appear on the banzuke after that. The stars are your own guess and can be wrong.
stable.title: Disciples ({count} / {cap})
policy.label: Training
basho.label: Year {year}, {name}
banzuke.note: ◆ marks your wrestlers. Records are from last tournament.
ledger.title: Ledger (last 2 months)
ledger.note: Association payments use reported real amounts. Expenses and supporters are estimates. Stable deficits come out of the master's savings; when those run out, the stable closes.
lineage.title: Masters of the line
lineage.successorNote: At 65 you choose a successor from the stable's elders. To become an elder a wrestler needs the qualification (1 tournament in sanyaku, 20 in makuuchi or 30 as sekitori, and Japanese nationality) and a free elder name. Free names now: {free}
lineage.kakunEmpty: None yet. One is added at each succession.
kakun.tachiai.name: Hit hard at the charge
kakun.yotsuFirst.name: Never let go of the belt
kakun.craft.name: Use the whole ring
kakun.chanko.name: Finish your chanko
kakun.chanko.desc: Bulk-up gains more weight. Food costs +10%
kakun.restDay.name: Rest is training too
kakun.thrift.name: Turn off the lights
kakun.title: Add a house rule
kakun.body: The first job of generation {generation}: keep one lesson from the previous era.
kakun.replace: The board is full. Replace which one?
report.title: Results: {basho}
report.noneMine: None of your disciples are on the banzuke.
report.retiredOyakata: {name} retires and stays on as an elder.
successor.title: Retirement age
successor.body: Master {name} is {age} and must retire. Choose who inherits the stable.
independence.title: Request to go independent
independence.body: Master {name} (formerly {shikona}, age {age}) wants a stable of his own.
independence.note: If you agree, he opens a branch stable in your ichimon. Branch promotions add to your prestige, and a branch can carry on the line if the main stable has no successor. He may take up to {max} disciples. Continuing without answering means you asked him to stay.
takeOver.title: No successor
takeOver.body: Master {name} is {age} and must retire, but no elder can inherit. You can close the main stable and take over a branch (your disciples move there).
family.title: Family tree
family.note: Under each master are the elders who came from his stable. Branch stables run on their own; their sekitori add to your prestige.
facility.title: Facilities and contracts
facility.note: Buildings are paid once from the stable account and have upkeep. Contracts are paid every tournament and can be changed any time. All amounts are estimates. Current cost per tournament: {upkeep}
facility.dorm.name: Dormitory extension
facility.dojo.name: Practice ring renovation
facility.dojo.desc: New ring, posts and equipment. Training grows 6% more per level
facility.trainer.name: Trainer and clinic
facility.trainer.desc: 20% fewer injuries per level, faster recovery
facility.scout.name: Scouting network
facility.scout.desc: Ties with schools and local clubs. More applicants and more accurate reads
bout.title: Day {day} bout
report.hoshitoriNote: ○ win ● loss ■ absent. Tap a mark to watch the bout.
jungyo.spring: Spring tour: sekitori travel the regions. A little tiring, but popularity grows.
jungyo.summer: Summer tour: sekitori travel the regions. The heat is tiring, but popularity grows.
jungyo.autumn: Autumn tour: sekitori travel the regions. A little tiring, but popularity grows.
jungyo.winter: Winter tour: sekitori travel the regions. A little tiring, but popularity grows.
newGame.artAria: The master in front of the stable curtain, a disciple stamping and a new recruit sliding
report.playoff: The makuuchi title went to a playoff ({names}).
hurt.label: Next tournament
hurt.note: Injured. Resting heals him but he sits out and drops in the rankings (there is no injury exemption). Playing protects his rank, but he is weaker and the injury may not heal or may get worse.
detail.honorsValue: Makuuchi titles {yusho}, other division titles {other}, Outstanding {shukun}, Fighting Spirit {kanto}, Technique {gino}, kinboshi {kinboshi}
detail.moneyValue: Received so far {earned} (salary, bonuses, prize banners, prizes), mochikyukin ¥{mochikyukin}
detail.toshiyoriOk: Qualified (can become an elder on retirement, if a name is free)
detail.toshiyoriLeft: To qualify: {sanyaku} more in sanyaku, {makuuchi} more in makuuchi or {sekitori} more as sekitori (any one)
detail.chartNote: Higher is better. Filled dot: winning record, hollow: losing, large: title. Hover a dot for rank and record.
detail.noTrack: No records yet (recorded while in your stable).
alumni.title: Former wrestlers ({count})
happening.supporterParty.title: Supporters' gathering
happening.supporterParty.body: The head of the supporters' club called: "Do bring the sekitori to the next gathering."
happening.supporterParty.withSekitori.de: Bigger gifts and more prestige. The sekitori get a little tired
happening.supporterParty.masterOnly.desc: Smaller gifts. The disciples keep training
happening.supporterParty.decline.desc: Nothing happens (the chairman looks a little lonely)
happening.demegeiko.title: Training invitation
happening.demegeiko.body: A strong stable invites your wrestlers to train at their ring.
happening.demegeiko.send.desc: Next training grows more. Tiring, with a small injury risk
happening.tvInterview.title: TV feature
happening.tvInterview.body: The evening news wants to follow a sekitori through his day.
happening.tvInterview.accept.desc: Prestige rises. The sekitori get a little tired
happening.kidsSumo.title: Kids' sumo
happening.kidsSumo.body: The local children's tournament asks to borrow your ring and have your disciples coach.
happening.kidsSumo.help.desc: Prestige rises. Some money for chanko, and the disciples get a little tired
happening.famousDoctor.title: A good doctor
happening.famousDoctor.body: A supporter offers to introduce a skilled orthopedist for the injured {name}.
happening.famousDoctor.treat.desc: The injury heals one tournament sooner
happening.promisingKid.title: A promising boy
happening.promisingKid.body: A local sumo contact says there is an amazing junior high student.
happening.promisingKid.visit.desc: A highly talented applicant joins the list (you still decide whether to accept)
happening.riceGift.title: Gift from rice country
happening.riceGift.body: A supporter from rice country sent a mountain of rice and vegetables.
happening.riceGift.thank.desc: Saves on food and adds a little prestige
happening.riceGift.receive.desc: Saves a little more on food
share.saveTree: Save the family tree as an image
share.failed: Could not make the image. Please try again.
assoc.title: Sumo Association (fictional)
assoc.note: Every stable belongs to one of five ichimon. When a master retires, a coach swaps elder names with him and inherits the stable; with no heir the stable closes and its wrestlers move within the ichimon. There are 105 elder names, and one must be free to become an elder.
assoc.noFree: No elder names are free right now.
journal.title: Stable journal
journal.note: Events of your stable and its branches. Names are as they were at the time.
journal.retire.oyakata: Takes the elder name {name} and stays as a coach.
journal.retire.stays: Stays in the Association as an elder.
journal.independence: Elder {stable} (former {shikona}) goes independent and opens {stable} stable.
journal.successor: Generation {generation}: elder {stable} (former {shikona}) takes over the stable.
journal.branchSucceeded: Former {shikona} takes over the branch {stable} stable.
journal.earlier: Smaller events before this point were not recorded.
save.title: Save file
save.note: Export a file to continue on another device or browser.
save.importError: This file could not be read (not an Ichimon save, or damaged).
save.importConfirm: Load {stable} stable (generation {generation}, year {year}). Your current stable will be replaced.
bout.tachiai.harizashi: {a} slaps and gets an inside grip.
bout.tachiai.migiyotsu: They lock up, right hand inside.
bout.tachiai.hidariyotsu: They lock up, left hand inside.
bout.beat.pressInEdge: {a} drives on. {b} is at the straw!
bout.beat.stall: They stall in the middle, both breathing hard.
happening.tanimachiDinner.title: Dinner with a patron
happening.tanimachiDinner.body: A longtime patron would like a quiet dinner with {name}.
happening.tanimachiDinner.go.desc: A little prestige. A little heavier and a little tired.
happening.tanimachiDinner.master.desc: You pay for a gift. A little prestige.
happening.newSponsor.title: A new sponsor
happening.newSponsor.body: The president of a local construction firm wants to join the supporters’ club.
happening.newSponsor.askMore.desc: ¥2M if it works. Nothing if not.
happening.sponsorScandal.title: Trouble at a sponsor
happening.sponsorScandal.body: A weekly magazine is reporting on a sponsor executive’s company. The stable is named in it.
happening.sponsorScandal.cutTies.desc: Lose ¥800k of support. Gain prestige for doing the right thing.
happening.sponsorScandal.stayQuiet.desc: It may blow over. If it doesn’t, prestige drops a lot.
happening.sponsorScandal.stayQuiet.hit: A follow-up story named the stable prominently.
happening.hometownCheer.title: Hometown supporters
happening.hometownCheer.body: {name}’s hometown wants to hold a cheering party.
happening.hometownCheer.go.desc: Gifts come in and {name} trains harder. A little tired.
happening.kenshoOffer.title: A sponsor banner
happening.kenshoOffer.body: A company wants to put prize banners on your sekitori’s bouts.
happening.merchandise.title: Stable merchandise
happening.merchandise.body: A vendor proposes making towels and teacups with your sekitori’s name.
happening.merchandise.make.desc: Returns ¥1.8M if it sells. It may not.
happening.merchandise.make.hit: The towels sold out during the tournament.
happening.merchandise.make.miss: Boxes of teacups are piling up.
happening.chankoVideo.title: Chanko video
happening.chankoVideo.body: A young wrestler wants to stream the stable’s chanko on video.
happening.chankoVideo.film.desc: A little prestige, a little fatigue. A hit brings ad money and more prestige.
happening.chankoVideo.film.hit: The views took off and ad money came in.
happening.rengoKeiko.title: Ichimon joint practice
happening.rengoKeiko.body: The ichimon is holding a joint practice day.
happening.rengoKeiko.attend.desc: Better training and some prestige. A little tired.
happening.soken.title: Open practice
happening.soken.body: Before the tournament there is an open practice in front of the Yokozuna Deliberation Council.
happening.soken.attend.desc: Tense training pays off. A little prestige and fatigue.
happening.kneeWorry.title: A sore knee
happening.kneeWorry.body: After practice, {name} keeps rubbing a knee.
happening.kneeWorry.rest.desc: Fatigue drops a lot, but the next training gains less.
happening.kneeWorry.pushOn.desc: Better gains, but there’s a risk of injury.
happening.guestCoach.title: A former yokozuna visits
happening.guestCoach.body: A retired yokozuna offers to come and coach for a few days.
happening.guestCoach.accept.desc: Everyone trains better next time. A little tired.
happening.bulkUp.title: Bulking up
happening.bulkUp.body: {name} says he wants to get bigger.
happening.bulkUp.eat.desc: +5 kg. A little extra food cost.
happening.bulkUp.balanced.desc: +2 kg and a small gain in his best skill.
happening.lateStudy.title: Late-night study
happening.lateStudy.body: {name} stays up late studying bout videos.
happening.strictSenior.title: A strict senior
happening.strictSenior.body: A senior wrestler drills {name} hard every morning.
happening.strictSenior.leave.desc: Strong gains. He might want to quit.
happening.summerCamp.title: Summer camp
happening.summerCamp.body: A town in the countryside offers to host a summer training camp.
happening.summerCamp.go.desc: Big training gains for everyone. Tiring. Some prestige.
happening.heatWave.title: Heat wave
happening.heatWave.body: The thermometer in the practice room passed 35°C.
happening.coldSnap.title: A cold snap
happening.coldSnap.body: The practice room is freezing in the morning.
happening.homesick.title: Homesick
happening.homesick.body: The new recruit {name} seems to be crying at night.
happening.homesick.homeVisit: Send him home for a few days
happening.runaway.title: Run away
happening.runaway.body: In the morning, {name}’s futon is empty and some things are gone.
happening.runaway.fetch.desc: Travel costs. He usually comes back.
happening.parentsVisit.title: Parents visit
happening.parentsVisit.body: {name}’s parents want to watch practice before the tournament.
happening.newChanko.title: New chanko
happening.newChanko.body: {name}, on chanko duty, came up with a new recipe.
happening.newChanko.praise.desc: Everyone gains a little weight. Slightly higher food cost.
happening.snsTrouble.title: Social media flap
happening.snsTrouble.body: A photo {name} posted is drawing unwanted attention.
happening.snsTrouble.apologize.desc: A little prestige lost, but it ends there.
happening.snsTrouble.phoneBan.desc: A little prestige lost. Grumbling wears everyone out.
happening.snsTrouble.ignore.desc: It may die down. If it spreads, prestige drops a lot.
happening.snsTrouble.ignore.hit: A daytime TV show picked it up.
happening.snsTrouble.ignore.miss: By the next day no one remembered.
happening.drinkingTrouble.title: Trouble at a bar
happening.drinkingTrouble.body: A bar called: {name} caused a scene last night.
happening.drinkingTrouble.punish.desc: Less training next time. A little prestige for taking it seriously.
happening.drinkingTrouble.protect.desc: Nothing if it stays quiet. A big prestige loss if it gets out.
happening.drinkingTrouble.protect.hit: It ended up in a weekly magazine.
happening.wedding.title: Wedding news
happening.wedding.body: {name} came to say he wants to get married.
happening.wedding.celebrate.desc: Prestige up and {name} is fired up.
happening.japaneseClass.title: Japanese lessons
happening.japaneseClass.school.desc: He settles in and trains a bit better.
happening.japaneseClass.self: He can learn at the stable
happening.alumniVisit.title: A former wrestler visits
happening.alumniVisit.body: A retired wrestler from the stable drops by with snacks to watch practice.
happening.alumniVisit.welcome: Ask him to coach a bit
happening.alumniVisit.welcome.desc: Small training gains for everyone and a little prestige.
happening.quarrel.title: A quarrel
happening.quarrel.body: {name} and a junior are arguing over chanko duty.
happening.quarrel.letThem.desc: {name} trains a bit better, but may get hurt.
happening.veteranDoubt.title: A veteran’s doubts
happening.veteranDoubt.body: {name} mutters that it might be time to retire.
happening.veteranDoubt.encourage.desc: He trains harder. A little tired.
happening.veteranDoubt.respect.desc: He will likely ask to retire.
happening.leakyRoof.title: Leaky roof
happening.leakyRoof.body: After heavy rain, the practice room ceiling is leaking.
happening.leakyRoof.patch.desc: Cheap if it holds. If not, another ¥1M to fix it properly.
happening.leakyRoof.patch.hit: It leaked again in the next rain.
happening.managerQuits.title: Manager wants out
happening.managerQuits.body: The stable manager asks for better pay or he’ll leave.
happening.managerQuits.letGo.desc: Chores fall to the wrestlers. A little prestige lost.
happening.taxAudit.title: Tax audit
happening.taxAudit.body: The tax office wants to examine the stable’s books.
happening.taxAudit.selfHandle.desc: It may go fine. If not, ¥1.5M in back taxes.
happening.taxAudit.selfHandle.hit: Some expenses were disallowed. You paid back taxes.
happening.lodging.title: Tournament lodging
happening.lodging.body: It’s time to choose lodging for the regional tournament.
happening.lodging.temple.desc: Room to train. Slightly better gains.
happening.nutritionist.title: A nutritionist
happening.nutritionist.body: A sports nutritionist offers to review the chanko menu.
happening.nutritionist.hire.desc: Less fatigue and slightly better training for everyone.
happening.chiropractor.title: A chiropractor
happening.chiropractor.body: A chiropractor says he can cure any fatigue.
happening.chiropractor.try.desc: If it works, everyone feels fresher.
happening.chiropractor.try.hit: Everyone seems lighter on their feet.
happening.chiropractor.try.miss: Maybe it was all in their heads.
happening.ichimonMeeting.title: Ichimon meeting
happening.ichimonMeeting.body: An invitation to the ichimon elders’ meeting has arrived.
happening.ichimonMeeting.attend.desc: Fee from your savings. A little prestige.
happening.associationDuty.title: Association duty
happening.associationDuty.body: The Association has assigned you judging duty during the tournament.
happening.associationDuty.accept.desc: Prestige up. Less time to watch practice.
happening.hospitalVisit.title: Hospital visit
happening.hospitalVisit.body: A children’s hospital asks for a visit from your sekitori.
happening.disasterRelief.title: Disaster relief
happening.disasterRelief.body: A town hit by an earthquake needs help serving hot meals.
happening.disasterRelief.go: Go with the wrestlers to serve chanko
happening.overseasEvent.title: Overseas exhibition
happening.overseasEvent.body: The Association asks if your sekitori can join an overseas exhibition.
happening.newYearVisit.title: New Year
happening.newYearVisit.shrine.desc: A little prestige and a fresh start.
happening.setsubun.title: Setsubun bean-throwing
happening.setsubun.body: A shrine invites your sekitori to throw beans at Setsubun.
happening.setsubun.go.desc: A fee and a little prestige.
happening.collegeStar.title: A college champion
happening.collegeStar.body: This year’s college champion is unsure about turning pro.
happening.collegeStar.visit.desc: If he likes you, a very talented candidate joins the list.
happening.highSchoolCoach.title: A high school coach
happening.highSchoolCoach.body: A high school sumo coach wants you to look at one of his students.
happening.overseasProspect.title: A prospect from abroad
happening.overseasProspect.body: A wrestler from overseas wrote that he wants to do sumo (one foreign-born wrestler per stable).
happening.overseasProspect.meet.desc: A foreign-born candidate joins the list.
happening.surgery.title: Surgery?
happening.surgery.body: The doctor says surgery would make {name}’s injury less likely to recur.
happening.surgery.operate.desc: One more tournament out, but less injury-prone afterwards.
staff.title: Staff and chanko
staff.note: Wakaimonogashira and sewanin are Association staff, hired from retired juryo and makushita wrestlers on their stablemaster’s recommendation (the Association pays them). Choose one of each from your former wrestlers. Skill depends on their highest rank.
staff.wakaimonogashira.name: Wakaimonogashira
staff.wakaimonogashira.desc: Supervises young wrestlers. Makushita and below train better.
staff.sewanin.name: Sewanin
staff.sewanin.desc: Handles equipment and chores. Faster recovery, fewer injuries.
diet.title: Chanko policy
diet.standard.name: Standard
diet.hearty.name: Hearty
diet.hearty.desc: Wrestlers bulk up faster, but knees and backs suffer.
diet.balanced.name: Balanced
diet.frugal.name: Frugal
diet.frugal.desc: Cheaper, but wrestlers don’t grow and stay tired.
highlight.promotion.sekitori.title: Promoted to juryo
highlight.promotion.sekitori.body: {name} has been promoted to juryo and is now a sekitori. From now on he draws a salary, gets attendants, wears a silk belt and can tie the ginkgo-leaf topknot.
highlight.promotion.makuuchi.title: Into makuuchi
highlight.promotion.makuuchi.body: {name} has reached makuuchi, ranked {rank} next tournament. He will enter the ring ceremony in an apron from his supporters.
highlight.promotion.O.title: Promoted to ozeki
highlight.promotion.O.body: The board has approved {name}’s promotion to ozeki. Envoys from the Association come to the stable to deliver the news.
highlight.promotion.Y.title: Promoted to yokozuna
highlight.promotion.Y.body: On the recommendation of the Yokozuna Deliberation Council, {name} has been promoted to yokozuna. Envoys from the Association come to the stable to deliver the news.
highlight.yusho.title: {division} champion
highlight.yusho.body: {name} won the title with {wins} wins and {losses} losses.
highlight.yusho.makuuchi: {name} won the makuuchi title with {wins} wins and {losses} losses. He holds the Emperor’s Cup and rides in the victory parade. The stable is preparing a celebration.
highlight.sansho.title: Special prize
highlight.sansho.body: {name} received the {prizes}. Each prize is worth ¥3M.
highlight.ceremony.lead: Choose the words of acceptance. He will put his resolve as {rank} into a four-character idiom.
highlight.ceremony.kojo: "I humbly accept. So as not to shame the name of {rank}, I will devote myself to sumo in the spirit of {word}."
dohyoiri.unryu.name: Unryu style
dohyoiri.unryu.desc: As he rises, the right arm extends and the left hand rests near his side. The rope has a single loop. Said to balance attack and defense.
dohyoiri.shiranui.name: Shiranui style
dohyoiri.shiranui.desc: As he rises, both arms spread wide. The rope has two loops. Said to be the attacking style.
journal.kojoDohyoiri: {shikona}’s yokozuna promotion ceremony. Idiom: "{word}". Ring entry: {dohyoiri}.
newGame.artCaption: Train your wrestlers. Build a home. Leave a legacy.
newGame.styleHelp: Your former specialty helps pupils of the same style grow.
bout.fusen: {loser} is absent, so {winner} wins by default.
traits.unknown: Not known yet (becomes clear after a few tournaments)
trait.diligent.name: Diligent
trait.lazy.name: Lazy
trait.bigStage.name: Big-stage
trait.practiceChamp.name: Practice champion
trait.practiceChamp.desc: Strong in practice, stiff in tournaments
trait.tough.name: Tough
trait.fragileBody.name: Injury-prone
trait.glutton.name: Big eater
trait.popular.name: Crowd favorite
trait.popular.desc: Draws sponsor banners in makuuchi; boosts stable prestige as a sekitori
trait.sensitive.name: Sensitive
trait.sensitive.desc: More likely to want to quit before reaching sekitori
trait.studious.name: Studious
trait.calm.name: Calm
trait.calm.desc: Steady form from tournament to tournament
rival.title: Rival stable
rival.note: Your contemporary’s stable. Beating them in sekitori bouts raises prestige. They compete for top recruits; hesitate and the recruit joins them.
journal.rival.new: You start to see {stable} stable, run by a contemporary, as your rival.
journal.rival.yusho: Rival {stable} stable’s {shikona} wins the makuuchi title.
journal.rival.O: Rival {stable} stable’s {shikona} is promoted to ozeki.
happening.rivalDemegeiko.title: A rival’s invitation
happening.rivalDemegeiko.body: Your rival, the master of {rival} stable, invites your wrestlers to train together.
happening.rivalDemegeiko.send.desc: Big gains and some prestige, but very tiring and risky
happening.rivalTaunt.title: Rival’s remark
happening.rivalTaunt.body: A sports paper quotes the master of {rival} stable: "I can’t see us losing to the young stables."
happening.rivalTaunt.fireUp.desc: Everyone trains harder. A little tiring
happening.rivalTaunt.laugh.desc: Your composure earns a little prestige
election.title: Board election
election.recommended: The biennial board election follows this tournament. Your ichimon has nominated you for {seat}.
election.notRecommended: The biennial board election follows this tournament. Your ichimon did not nominate you. Running anyway forces a vote (about {percent}% chance to win).
election.note: With your ichimon’s backing it is settled without a vote. Running without it raises prestige if you win and costs prestige if you lose. Directors earn more and gain prestige, but without a coach in the stable they have less time for practice.
board.title: The board
board.none: No election yet (every two years, after the January tournament).
board.note: Offices rise from elder to chief, committee member and senior committee member; directors are elected and the chairman is chosen from them.
journal.election.electedRebel: Ran without the ichimon’s backing and was elected {office}.
journal.election.lostRebel: Ran without the ichimon’s backing and lost.
koenkai.title: Supporters’ club
koenkai.party.none.desc: No cost, but membership shrinks and patrons cool off.
koenkai.party.small.desc: A modest celebration at the stable. Normal membership growth.
koenkai.party.grand.desc: A grand hotel party. Membership grows, patrons warm up and prestige rises.
koenkai.noPatrons: No patrons right now. They come as you produce sekitori and gain prestige.
koenkai.note: Member dues and patrons’ gifts reach the stable account each tournament. Patrons are pleased when their favorite wins or is promoted; left alone they slowly cool off (visits are paid from your savings). All amounts are estimates.
patron.kind.brewery: The head of the {surname} sake brewery
scout.title: Go scouting
scout.note: The master goes out to meet prospects. Anyone you meet joins the candidate list (you still decide whether to accept). Once per tournament, paid from the stable account (estimates).
scout.doneNote: You already went this tournament. You can go again next time.
scout.noMoney: Not enough in the stable account
scout.foreignLimit: Only one foreign-born wrestler per stable
scout.juniorHighMeet.name: National junior high tournament
scout.juniorHighMeet.desc: The August national meet. Meet 1–3 fifteen-year-olds with lots of room to grow
scout.interHigh.name: High school nationals
scout.interHigh.desc: The August high school championships. Meet 1–2 experienced 18-year-olds
scout.collegeMeet.name: National college championships
scout.collegeMeet.desc: The November college championships. Meet 1–2 ready-made 22-year-olds
scout.countryside.name: Follow up local rumors
scout.countryside.desc: Meet 0–2 athletes from other sports. You may come back empty-handed
scout.overseas.name: Go abroad
scout.overseas.desc: Meet one talented young athlete from abroad. Expensive
journal.scoutNone: Went to {trip} but found no one promising.
guide.title: Getting started
guide.lead: Start here. Steps are checked off as you go.
guide.step.policy: Choose each wrestler’s training (push, belt, technique, body, rest)
guide.step.basho: Press “To the tournament” to play the 15 days
guide.step.bout: In the results, press a ○/● mark to watch the bout
guide.step.ledger: Open the Ledger tab to see the money
guide.tip.stable: Stable: set training, answer recruits and events. When ready, press “To the tournament” below.
guide.tip.banzuke: Rankings: every wrestler’s rank. Yours are marked ◆. Switch divisions at the top.
guide.tip.ledger: Ledger: last tournament’s money. Manage supporters, staff, chanko and facilities here. Deficits come out of your savings.
guide.tip.lineage: Lineage: past masters and the family tree. Coaches you raise become heirs or open branch stables.
guide.tip.association: Association: your rival, the board, the five ichimon and free elder names.
guide.tip.journal: Journal: the stable’s history. Export and import saves here too.
highlight.danpatsu.title: Hair-Cutting Ceremony
highlight.danpatsu.kokugikan: At the Kokugikan, the retirement ceremony for {name} (highest rank {rank}). After bouts and sumo songs, about {hasami} people stepped onto the ring one by one to snip his topknot.
highlight.danpatsu.hotel: In a hotel banquet hall, the hair-cutting ceremony for {name} (highest rank {rank}). About {hasami} people took a snip of his topknot.
highlight.danpatsu.cut: Finally, his master {master} made the last cut, and the topknot fell.
highlight.danpatsu.afterOyakata: From now on he stays as an elder, raising the next wrestlers.
highlight.danpatsu.afterLeave: {name} heads into a second life without a topknot.
journal.danpatsu.kokugikan: Retirement ceremony for {shikona} at the Kokugikan. About {hasami} people took a snip.
journal.danpatsu.hotel: Hair-cutting ceremony for {shikona}. About {hasami} people took a snip.
fame.title: Hall of Fame ({count})
fame.note: Former wrestlers who reached yokozuna or ozeki, won a top-division title, or took 5+ special prizes. Tap for details.
fame.empty: No one yet. When a yokozuna, ozeki or top-division champion retires, his name stays here.
records.title: Stable Records
records.empty: No pupil has appeared on the banzuke yet.
records.note: Current pupils are marked "Active". When one breaks a record, you hear about it after the tournament.
highlight.record.title: Stable Record
highlight.record.body: {name} set a new stable record for {record}: {value} (previously {prevName}, {prevValue}).
